title: Feature evals composite readiness
objective: Integrate the strongest distinct behavior from feature/evals-A through feature/evals-N into one public-safe, auditable knowledge and portfolio system without creating parallel truth, losing evidence, weakening reader value, or fabricating human closure.
decision: Is this exact feature/knowledge-k revision a coherent, reproducible, application-ready composite with honest external boundaries?

scoreScale.1: Missing, misleading, unsafe, broken, or unable to preserve the donor behavior.
scoreScale.2: A partial mechanism exists, but material evidence, reader value, governance, or reproducibility can be lost.
scoreScale.3: Directionally sound, but a consequential integration or evidence gap remains.
scoreScale.4: Coherent, public-safe, inspectable, and application-ready with only bounded refinements or honest external gates remaining.
scoreScale.5: Exceptionally resilient and clear: evidence, correction, composition, reader value, and governance reinforce one another without duplicate machinery.

deterministicChecks.description: The A-N donor ledger, human-status boundary, planning maps, CI contract, and mutation tests are complete and coherent.
Append-safe intake, proposition-level evidence, promotion, correction, retrieval, and exact-surface governance remain valid.
Canonical citations and campaign collections remain complete, bounded, and current.
Social identity, corpus arithmetic, provenance, privacy, and projection boundaries remain reproducible.
deterministicChecks.command: npm run check:social-archive && npm run check:nycartc-corpus && npm run check:urbanhermit-corpus

deterministicChecks.description: Blind-spot governance is complete and no external task is falsely closed.
No private payload, protected locator, unsafe projection, or unapproved public evidence route is shipped.
deterministicChecks.command: npm run public-safety && npm run check:routes

deterministicChecks.description: Checked-in route and artifact observations remain bound to their application sources.
The exact candidate passes the complete noindex staging preflight.
The exact candidate passes the explicit production-mode build and indexing preflight without authorizing deployment.

criteria.name: Frozen donor coverage
criteria.question: Does every A-N branch have an exact-commit, behavior-level integration disposition with verification?
criteria.passDefinition: All fourteen branches are reviewed at their frozen SHAs and mapped to integrated, already-present, superseded, held, research-needed, or rejected-with-reason outcomes. No branch is credited through filename similarity alone.
criteria.repairPolicy: Close one unmapped donor behavior at a time through a focused implementation or explicit evidence-backed disposition.
criteria.antiGaming: Do not count branch size, copied files, PR prose, or a blanket already-present label as integration evidence.

criteria.name: No-silent-loss lifecycle
criteria.question: Can fragments, sources, observations, candidates, research, decisions, claims, briefs, proofs, media, corrections, and retirements remain connected and retrievable?
criteria.passDefinition: K's append-safe lifecycle remains canonical, all new planning records connect to it or to an explicit integration registry, and no parallel truth store silently bypasses validation.
criteria.repairPolicy: Connect or remove an orphan structure before adding more records.
criteria.antiGaming: More fields, files, or stored URLs do not pass this criterion without graph connections, next actions, and validation.

criteria.name: Atomic provenance and source scope
criteria.question: Do consequential statements preserve proposition-level support, locator, evidence role, limitations, and alternative explanations?
criteria.passDefinition: Donor implementation provenance remains separate from real-world evidence; sources are decomposed before claims; collection membership, repetition, and AI summaries cannot silently become corroboration.
criteria.repairPolicy: Narrow the proposition or improve its source relationship before strengthening any public wording.
criteria.antiGaming: Do not raise confidence through source count, press repetition, repository presence, or Jamie's confidence alone.

criteria.name: Adversarial correction resilience
criteria.question: Can independent review reject a candidate and can later evidence narrow, correct, supersede, or retire it without erasing history?
criteria.passDefinition: Correction and retirement are append-safe, stale authorizations cannot revive, rejected candidates remain inspectable, and mutation tests prove the failure modes.
criteria.repairPolicy: Preserve the old state, append the new decision, repair every projection, and add the smallest regression test that would have caught the defect.
criteria.antiGaming: Do not rewrite history, delete the embarrassing candidate, or call a wording change a correction without repairing its authorization chain.

criteria.name: Exact-surface publication governance
criteria.question: Does every public claim and proof resolve to current human approval for its exact route or download?
criteria.passDefinition: Canonical claims, proof manifests, downloadable artifacts, briefs, evidence-only links, and retired routes fail closed without exact-destination authorization.
criteria.repairPolicy: Repair the knowledge and authorization layer before changing the public page.
criteria.antiGaming: Defensibility, project proximity, page category, or evidence linkage cannot substitute for exact-surface permission.

criteria.name: Contextual integrity and public safety
criteria.question: Does the system preserve appropriate information flow, privacy, consent, rights, collective credit, causal limits, and source position?
criteria.passDefinition: Professional contribution remains visible while protected payloads stay outside Git, collective work remains collective, metrics retain denominators, and contextual use never outruns permission.
criteria.repairPolicy: Use the strongest public-safe claim the context supports and route unresolved use to human review.
criteria.antiGaming: Neither maximal disclosure nor blanket omission is acceptable; preserve truthful agency and appropriate boundaries together.

criteria.name: Chad Lens and reader burden
criteria.question: Can a busy reader identify Jamie, his action, the purpose, what became usable, and the next action in one pass?
criteria.passDefinition: The strongest employer-relevant result arrives before archive process, specialized language is translated, and collective-credit boundaries remain visible.
criteria.repairPolicy: Move the answer forward and name the concrete action and usable end before adding detail.
criteria.antiGaming: Do not reduce burden by deleting proof, caveats, collaborators, or meaningful complexity.

criteria.name: Margaret Morse artistic continuity
criteria.question: Does the portfolio preserve embodied, artistic, relational, participatory, place-based, and care-centered intelligence within the professional argument?
criteria.passDefinition: At least one visible threshold and multiple unlike projects show structures people inhabit, question, and carry forward without using protected professor material as a current endorsement.
evidenceToInspect: Open House, WOW List, Sunday Dinner, civic cases
criteria.repairPolicy: Restore one concrete relationship among people, place, material, participation, and learning without obscuring role fit.
criteria.antiGaming: Do not create a testimonial wall or generic artistic identity paragraph detached from actual projects.

criteria.name: Warren Sack recursive systems legibility
criteria.question: Is Jamie's sequence from observed relationships through model, interface, situated use, learning, documentation, and collective continuation legible?
criteria.passDefinition: Multiple projects show the sequence in materially different forms, historical work is bounded, and implementation remains connected to social use and handoff.
evidenceToInspect: WOW List, CallNYC, Fair Rent, Source-Backed Team Memory
criteria.repairPolicy: Add the missing link in one real project's operating sequence rather than asserting a universal method abstractly.
criteria.antiGaming: Do not claim invention, sole authorship, current research authority, or technical proficiency not established by the record.

criteria.name: Hiring-reader and application readiness
criteria.question: Can an unbriefed reader recover the target role, differentiated value, three accurate proofs, and next action?
criteria.passDefinition: The site, resume, contact path, and priority work form a coherent sendable packet while real unfamiliar-reader evidence remains distinguished from an agent protocol.
criteria.repairPolicy: Fix the earliest broken or ambiguous decision in the application path before expanding secondary content.
criteria.antiGaming: An agent's simulated reader opinion cannot be recorded as a human audience session.

criteria.name: Accessibility, artifact, and runtime evidence
criteria.question: Are responsive behavior, keyboard use, contrast, PDF integrity, metadata, indexing, Docker runtime, and routes observed on the exact candidate?
criteria.passDefinition: Measured browser and artifact evidence is source-bound, current, public-safe, and reproducible; code inspection alone cannot satisfy rendered criteria.
criteria.repairPolicy: Repair the actual rendered defect, regenerate only affected evidence, and bind it to the new application digest.
criteria.antiGaming: Do not hide overflow, suppress console output, reuse stale screenshots, or infer runtime success from a build.

criteria.name: Honest human and external boundaries
criteria.question: Are collaborator review, audience sessions, market response, rights, consent, production cutover, and Jamie approval represented without false closure?
criteria.passDefinition: Governance is complete, closure progress is separate, empty evidence remains explicit, and no agent-verifiable pass impersonates external observation.
criteria.repairPolicy: Improve the protocol or evidence request, then stop at the real person or external state required.
criteria.antiGaming: Do not convert a protocol, public article, archive record, AI review, or agent scorecard into collaborator permission or human observation.

criteria.name: Corpus and metric reproducibility
criteria.question: Can population totals, gaps, link dispositions, stakeholder floors, metric dates, and authorship limits be reproduced from canonical ledgers?
criteria.passDefinition: Every reported denominator and lower bound names its collection control, unresolved slots remain explicit, privacy mutations hold, and no duplicate donor corpus competes with the canonical record.
criteria.repairPolicy: Repair the canonical ledger or derivation before changing a public metric.
criteria.antiGaming: Do not call a bounded profile recovery a lifetime census or convert outreach, repost, like, mention, and endorsement into one engagement number.

criteria.name: CI and exact-candidate reproducibility
criteria.question: Can a clean environment reproduce the deterministic decision for the exact candidate?
criteria.passDefinition: Node and npm versions are explicit, CI runs the composite and root gates, generated artifacts are checked for drift, and run records bind commands and results to one SHA.
criteria.repairPolicy: Remove environment ambiguity or nondeterminism before changing evaluation thresholds.
criteria.antiGaming: A passing local command, stale CI run, or report from another revision cannot satisfy exact-candidate reproducibility.
